productIntent.goal: Provide a lightweight deterministic EVO Runtime Plugin whose minimal routing spine is applicationId → BusinessData → current PostingRules → Ledger/Balance. EVO owns only the ApplicationAnchor needed for rule routing; rich platform/application/permission/governance capabilities remain outside.

currentStage.name: Generic BusinessData Submission Convergence
currentStage.businessGoal: Implement a minimal generic BusinessData submission boundary with mandatory applicationId so EVO can route each fact to the correct current PostingRules while preserving compatibility behavior.

activeRequirementSet.name: Generic BusinessData Submission Convergence
acceptance: EVO Core owns a minimal ApplicationAnchor/applicationId registry used only for PostingRule routing
every accepted BusinessData item carries applicationId
every executable PostingRule carries applicationId and candidate selection filters by exact applicationId before condition evaluation

define a generic BusinessDataSubmission contract that requires applicationId/ApplicationAnchor routing but does not require rich Enterprise/Application lifecycle, permissions, capabilities or Command objects inside EVO Core
support an opaque runtime scope key for isolation without Core-owned enterprise metadata
accepted BusinessData automatically enters the existing Posting lifecycle
PostingRules are supplied to Core through a plugin/Host boundary without Core rule-version governance
current /api/v1/commands path can adapt into the new submission boundary during migration
existing Proof C compatibility behavior remains available until the Host adapter replacement is proven
PostgreSQL E2E proves generic submission → BusinessData → Posting → Ledger/Balance
no broad module extraction is performed before this contract is proven
verified: CORE-MIN-01 minimal EVO Runtime Plugin boundary merged by PR #56 / CI #738
App Platform documents EVO as an ordinary lightweight runtime dependency package
superseded PR #25 and PR #50 are closed

alignmentCadence.countingRule: Count merged bounded slices whose evidence level is DATABASE E2E VERIFIED or CERTIFIED.
alignmentCadence.triggerRule: Run formal alignment at the third slice or any mandatory event trigger, whichever comes first.
alignmentCadence.resetRule: Reset the slice counter after a formal alignment review is recorded in lastAlignment.

nextRequirementSelection.rule: Do not select another broad architecture packet until the generic submission path is implemented and PostgreSQL E2E verified.

findings: legacy Asloop/bookkeeping semantics include explicit debit/credit concepts
current EVO generic ledger uses signed quantity/amount and does not enforce balanced journals
financial accounting must be layered as an explicit General Ledger projection rather than forcing operational ledgers into debit/credit terminology
invariants: each General Ledger journal has at least one debit and one credit line
sum(debit) equals sum(credit) under pinned accounting precision
financial statements derive from authoritative accounting state and never rewrite canonical BusinessData
